summary: 동아시아 전역에 사는 갈매기과 철새로, 적호갈매기라고도 부른다. 카자흐스탄, 러시아, 몽골의 일부 지역에서 번식하는데, 번식지의 물 양이 달라지면서 번식 성공률이 낮다. 러시아와 중국에서는 사람의 방해와 나쁜 날씨로 번식지 여건이 나빠지고 있다.
young: 첫겨울 어린새는 머리가 거의 희고 뒷목에 짙은 줄무늬 띠가 있으며, 등은 옅은 회색이고 셋째날개깃 가운데가 어둡고 날개덮깃에 갈색 기가 돈다. 날 때는 바깥쪽 첫째날개깃과 꼬리 끝의 띠가 짙은 갈색으로 보인다.

art.subject: Relict Gull (Ichthyaetus relictus), adult in winter plumage, as seen on Korean west-coast tidal flats in winter: head white with fine dusky grey streaking on the rear crown and nape; dark eye; neck, underparts and tail white; mantle and upperwings pale grey; outer primaries black with white tips and small white mirrors; bill short and thick, dark red; legs dark red.
art.scene: Korean west-coast tidal flat in winter (December–February), low tide with wet mud and cold light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter, side view standing on mud: angular head with fine dusky streaks on the rear crown and nape, dark eye, pale grey back, black wingtips with white spots, short thick dark red bill, dark red legs
adult winter, head detail in profile: angular head shape, white head with fine dusky streaks on the rear crown and nape, dark eye, short deep dark red bill
adult breeding (spring), side view standing: blackish hood with bold white crescents above and below the eye, white neck, pale grey back, dark red bill and legs
art.build: Medium-sized, stocky hooded gull, clearly larger and heavier than Black-headed Gull, with an angular head. Bill short, thick and deep for its length, with a blunt tip, dark red. Legs dark red. At rest the black wingtips project well beyond the tail. In flight pale grey wings end in a black wingtip marked with white mirrors.
avoid: Do not paint a slim bill and a white leading edge to the outer wing; that is Black-headed Gull (Chroicocephalus ridibundus).
Do not paint a short black bill on a small gull; that is Saunders's Gull (Saundersilarus saundersi).
Do not paint a yellow or orange bill or legs; both are dark red.
Do not show a full black hood in the midwinter scene.
